newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Three children die in Kazakhstan fire.
newsitem.headline: Three children die in Kazakhstan fire.

text.p: Three children died in northern Kazakhstan when the electric heater in their home caught fire, officials said on Friday.
A spokesman for the State Commettee for Emergency Situations said the children aged six, four and two from the village of Sergeyevskaya died of asphyxiation in the smoke on Thursday.

Energy shortages in the oil and gas-rich Central Asian republic have prompted many people to rig up makeshift heating systems. On Tuesday a gas explosion ripped through an apartment block in the town of Semipalatinsk, killing at least one person.
